units_convention: powers in MW (daily average), energies in MWh/day unless stated, prices in GBP per MWh (nominal, no deflator applied), costs in GBP

claims.meaning: Identity of the supplied daily price series: closest real-world analogue is the BSC Market Index Price (half-hourly volume-weighted short-term wholesale trade index), not a retail tariff, PPA price, CfD strike/reference price or Smart Export Guarantee rate.
claims.value: treat avg_price_GBP_per_MWh as a daily average of the GB half-hourly wholesale index; use as unit revenue for sold MWh under perfect foresight and full contracting
claims.scope: supplied daily_market_index_price.csv; Great Britain wholesale electricity
claims.recommended_baseline: adopt as p_t; label as index-based merchant revenue
claims.notes: Inference from the file name plus the BSC definition; SOURCE_MANIFEST.json lists only column names and does not state which index, aggregation method, or weighting.

claims.meaning: Exact unit identity between the two supplied price columns: GBP per MW-day equals 24 times GBP per MWh, because 1 MW held for 24 h is 24 MWh.
claims.recommended_baseline: use avg_price_GBP_per_MWh only; cross-check against avg_price_GBP_per_MW_day / 24
claims.notes: Max absolute deviation 0.000000 over 2422 rows; 0 rows exceed tolerance 0.05. Multiplying the MW-day column by 24 again is a 24x revenue error.

claims.meaning: Mean of the supplied daily price series over its full coverage.
claims.recommended_baseline: descriptive only; not a forecast

claims.meaning: Minimum (most negative) daily average price in the supplied series.
claims.recommended_baseline: retain; do not clip
claims.sensitivity_range: clamp to 0 as labelled tail treatment (scenario S2)

claims.meaning: Maximum daily average price in the supplied series.
claims.recommended_baseline: retain as genuine extreme (BL-11)

claims.meaning: Median of the supplied daily price series; far below the mean, indicating a right-skewed distribution driven by crisis-period peaks.
claims.recommended_baseline: report both mean and median; battery value depends on dispersion, not the mean

claims.meaning: The rule used to aggregate half-hourly settlement-period prices into the supplied daily figure is not documented in any supplied file, nor is whether the aggregation is volume-weighted.
claims.recommended_baseline: assume an equal-weighted daily mean of settlement-period prices and declare the assumption in the run manifest
claims.notes: Crossing issue for R4/D-01; affects level in spiky periods because Elexon MIP is volume-weighted within each settlement period while a daily mean may not be.

claims.meaning: Whether the supplied demand series D_t acts as a real market absorption quota for a generator. It does not; there is no per-generator rationing against demand in the GB wholesale market.
claims.value: D_t is a constructed-system modelling convention (integrated portfolio), not a market rule; the only real limit on a generator is connection/Transmission Entry Capacity
claims.scope: BL-02 interpretation; regime A and B
claims.recommended_baseline: keep the D_t cap as specified in BL-02 but label it explicitly as modelled; run the merchant variant (no cap) as sensitivity S3
claims.notes: Policy B (q_t = min{G_t, D_t}) remains well defined either way; only its economic interpretation changes.

claims.meaning: Default daily export cap for the baseline interface, taken from the observed maximum output of the specified wind farm.
claims.recommended_baseline: E_cap = 1125 MW (x 24 h for the daily energy cap) unless the team documents a connection size
claims.notes: A real connection limit is a MW cap; it is not a demand-linked energy cap.

claims.meaning: Mean of the supplied daily demand series.
claims.recommended_baseline: use as supplied

claims.meaning: Demand converted to daily energy at the mean, using average MW x 24 h.
claims.recommended_baseline: MWh/day = MW x 24 consistently for all series

claims.meaning: Mean total generation converted to daily energy; the gap to demand is the constructed system's average shortfall.
claims.recommended_baseline: use as supplied; do not add fuel rows to the total
claims.notes: 25583 MW x 24 h = 613992 MWh/day; shortfall vs demand 60720 MWh/day.

claims.meaning: Whether grid purchases are enabled in the baseline trading interface.
claims.scope: baseline run; regime A and B
claims.recommended_baseline: purchases off (concurs with BL-07); enable only via scenario S4
claims.sensitivity_range: on with adder a in {0, 10, 20, 30} GBP/MWh
claims.notes: With no adder and no connection cap, imports at negative or cheap prices manufacture unbounded profit, which BL-07 prohibits.

claims.meaning: Per-MWh non-commodity adder that must sit between the wholesale index and any purchase price. No defensible numeric value obtained in this pass.
claims.value: a > 0, value unknown; bounded 0 to 30 for scenario use only
claims.price_year: would need to match the adopted price base year
claims.recommended_baseline: p_buy,t = p_t + a with a left as an open parameter; report break-even a rather than asserting a tariff
claims.notes: Ofgem's price cap decomposition shows network, policy, operating, EBIT, headroom and VAT components beyond wholesale, so a = 0 is known to be wrong; the numeric level belongs to R4 (F-01/F-03).

claims.meaning: Eligibility condition for buying electricity for resale in GB: a supply licence (or supply through a licensed third party).
claims.value: supplier licence required; a generator without one cannot contract imports for resale directly
claims.scope: GB electricity supply and BSC settlement
claims.recommended_baseline: declare the licence/third-party supply assumption if imports are enabled

claims.meaning: Count and share of days with a negative daily average price in the supplied series.
claims.recommended_baseline: retain all 9 days

claims.meaning: Treatment of negative prices in the model.
claims.value: retain negative values unchanged; a negative sale price means the optimal plan curtails or stores, and regime B pays for its priority rule on these days
claims.recommended_baseline: retain (BL-11); clamp-to-zero only as labelled tail treatment S2

claims.meaning: Simultaneous import and export at one connection is a metering impossibility; the model must restrict the metered net position, not internal charge/discharge.
claims.value: apply one price to net_t = sales - purchases - charge - h2_use + discharge; forbid sales_t > 0 and purchases_t > 0 on the same day via the net formulation or a binary switch
claims.recommended_baseline: net formulation (no binary variable needed)
claims.notes: Battery charging from current generation and discharging to the grid on the same day is internal conversion and must not be forbidden.

claims.meaning: Minimum sell/buy price ratio for a 2-hour battery to be worth cycling, given 90 percent round-trip efficiency and no adders.
claims.scope: derived from the brief's 90 percent round-trip assumption
claims.recommended_baseline: use as a screening check before believing any positive battery value

claims.meaning: Loss per MWh cycled through a battery when buy and sell prices are equal to the sample mean.
claims.recommended_baseline: state that storage cannot be justified by average prices, only by dispersion

claims.meaning: Mean output of the specified wind farm as a share of mean system demand; primary evidence for the price-taking assumption.
claims.recommended_baseline: price-taking for the farm's own output

claims.meaning: Maximum farm output as a share of mean system demand.
claims.recommended_baseline: price-taking remains defensible

claims.meaning: Maximum farm output as a share of 1st-percentile (low) demand, the tightest plausible instant.
claims.recommended_baseline: price-taking; report as the upper bound of the assumption's plausibility

claims.meaning: Any market-impact coefficient (GBP/MWh per GW offered) for a non-price-taking scenario. Not derivable from the supplied daily average series.
claims.value: unknown; requires half-hourly bid/offer and acceptance data
claims.recommended_baseline: maintain price-taking and report the output level that would move price by 1 percent rather than inventing a slope

claims.meaning: Baseline economic treatment of unused generation.
claims.value: zero revenue, zero cost, zero compensation; the lost sale is already the opportunity cost, so no separate curtailment penalty
claims.scope: baseline run, regime A and B
claims.recommended_baseline: adopt; avoids double counting with BL-09
claims.sensitivity_range: c_cur 0 to 20 GBP/MWh as labelled alternative-market scenario S6
claims.notes: Constraint payments arise through the Balancing Mechanism, which requires BM Unit registration; the constructed system has none, so eligibility is not claimed.

claims.meaning: BSUoS charge borne by a generator after the April 2023 charging reform.
claims.recommended_baseline: 0; do not deduct BSUoS from export revenue
claims.notes: CMP308 recovered BSUoS solely from final demand; CMP361 introduced an ex-ante fixed tariff; NESO marks generators as not charged.

claims.meaning: Basis of the TNUoS generation charge: levied on Transmission Entry Capacity per kW per year and zonal, not per MWh exported.
claims.value: GBP per kW of TEC per year, zonal; numeric tariff not obtained
claims.price_year: annual tariff set by 31 January, effective 1 April
claims.recommended_baseline: excluded from baseline dispatch (0); placeholder fixed-cost parameter for sensitivity S5
claims.sensitivity_range: to be filled from NESO published TNUoS tariff tables
claims.notes: Treating TNUoS as a per-MWh charge would distort dispatch; omitting it understates fixed cost, and a Scottish zone is likely above the national average.

claims.meaning: Other network-related costs omitted with the brief's grid simplification: connection charges, AAHEDC, and locational/transmission constraints.
claims.value: omitted; connection charges are capex, AAHEDC is a north-of-Scotland support charge, transmission limits are unmodelled
claims.recommended_baseline: state the omission and its direction of bias (fixed costs understated)
claims.notes: Consistent with TC-07; the model cannot establish actual Scottish curtailment or site deliverability.

claims.meaning: Eligibility of the modelled farm for the Smart Export Guarantee.
claims.value: ineligible: SEG applies to installations up to 5 MW
claims.recommended_baseline: exclude SEG from the interface; export route is wholesale/PPA only

claims.meaning: Presence of a CfD contract for the constructed system.
claims.value: none documented; CfD route not applicable and no CfD payment modelled
claims.recommended_baseline: exclude; a CfD-supported scenario would need the contract and the negative-pricing rule, which this pass did not obtain

claims.meaning: Size of the four-way date intersection available to a common A/B comparison window.
claims.scope: price, demand, generation total and wind farm; 2020-01-01 to 2026-09-17
claims.recommended_baseline: run all A/B comparisons on the intersection unless R4 defines a documented gap treatment
claims.notes: Relative to the intersection: 16 price/gen dates, 45 demand dates and 47 wind dates excluded. R4 owns D-02.

claims.meaning: Census of the demand file's recordType field, confirming a single record type and no duplicated mix of measurement classes.
claims.recommended_baseline: treat as a single homogeneous daily series; R4 to confirm the meaning of VD

claims.meaning: Current published GB baseload reference price level, used only to show that the 2020-2026 historical mean is not a forecast.
claims.scope: Baseload Market Reference Price, CfD settlement reference
claims.recommended_baseline: not used in the run; supports mandatory price-level sensitivity
claims.notes: More than twice the 2020-2026 supplied daily mean of 48.17 GBP/MWh.

claims.meaning: Revenue per MWh of electricity consumed by the electrolyser if all hydrogen sells at the written GBP 9.5/kg benchmark, using the written 55.9 kWh/kg conversion.
claims.unit: GBP per MWh of input electricity
claims.scope: electrolyser outlet, before capex and operating cost
claims.recommended_baseline: use as the H2 electricity-equivalent revenue for route comparison
claims.sensitivity_range: scaled by any alternative H2 price; R3 owns the price
claims.notes: 9.5 GBP/kg divided by 55.9 kWh/kg = 0.16995 GBP/kWh = 169.95 GBP/MWh.

claims.meaning: Annual gross electricity revenue of the specified farm at the sample mean price, before any cost; scale anchor for judging flexibility capex.
claims.recommended_baseline: report as an order-of-magnitude anchor, not a forecast
